title: The Bunny Who Never Shared His Crayons: The Colorful Masterpiece!

lines.text: Art class challenge! The teacher rolled out a giant paper mural across the floor!
lines.caps: Art class *CHALLENGE! | The teacher rolled out a giant *PAPER | mural across the *FLOOR!

lines.text: Benny the bunny sat guarding his luxury sixty-four crayon box with his paws!
lines.caps: Benny the bunny sat *GUARDING | his sixty-four crayon box with his *PAWS!

lines.text: May I borrow sky blue for my river? asked Penny. No, it's mine! Benny snapped!
lines.caps: May I borrow *SKY BLUE? | asked Penny. No, it's *MINE! | Benny *SNAPPED!

lines.text: Benny drew a big blue lake in his corner, but had no green for trees and no yellow for sun!
lines.caps: Benny drew a lake, but had *NO GREEN | for trees and no yellow for the *SUN!

lines.text: His picture was dull, while Penny and Leo traded pink, purple, and orange joyfully!
lines.caps: His picture was *DULL, | while his friends traded colors *JOYFULLY!

lines.text: Benny realized: One color alone can never paint a whole vibrant world!
lines.caps: Benny realized: One color *ALONE | can never paint a whole *VIBRANT | *WORLD!

lines.text: He slid his box to the center: Take whatever colors you need, everyone!
lines.caps: He slid his box to the *CENTER: | Take whatever colors you *NEED!

lines.text: Together they finished the most stunning rainbow forest the school had ever seen!
lines.caps: Together they finished the most *STUNNING | rainbow mural ever *SEEN!
